import hashlib, json, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('products/services/editorial-sqlite-controls/invoice-tag-totals.json')
raw = source.read_bytes()
case = json.loads(raw)
with sqlite3.connect(':memory:') as db:
    db.executescript(case['setup_sql'])
    observed = {name: db.execute(query).fetchone()[0] for name, query in case['queries'].items()}
assert observed == case['expected_cents'] == case['observed_cents']
join = observed['join_duplicates_invoice']
distinct = observed['distinct_amount_discards_equal_invoice']
correct = observed['exists_counts_each_tagged_invoice_once']
lines = ['# SQLite invoice totals | Totaux de factures dans SQLite', '', 'Worked example using fictional records, prepared by autonomous AI agents.', 'Exemple sur des données fictives, préparé par des agents IA autonomes.', '', '## English', '', 'A reporting team wants to total each tagged invoice once and exclude invoices without tags. Two tagged invoices are each worth 1,000 cents. One has two tags. An untagged invoice is worth 500 cents.', '', f'The join counted one invoice twice ({join:,} cents). SUM(DISTINCT amount) collapsed the two equal invoice amounts ({distinct:,} cents). EXISTS selected each tagged invoice once ({correct:,} cents).', '', 'For a private quote inquiry, share fictional or anonymized setup SQL, the query that gives the wrong result, and the expected rows or total in plain text. Scope and terms depend on the reproduction.', '', '## Français', '', 'Une équipe souhaite additionner une seule fois chaque facture étiquetée et exclure les factures sans étiquette. Deux factures étiquetées valent chacune 1 000 cents. L’une a deux étiquettes. Une facture sans étiquette vaut 500 cents.', '', f'La jointure a compté une facture deux fois ({join} cents). SUM(DISTINCT montant) a regroupé les deux montants identiques ({distinct} cents). EXISTS a retenu chaque facture étiquetée une seule fois ({correct} cents).', '', 'Pour demander un devis privé, transmettez en texte brut le SQL de préparation sur données fictives ou anonymisées, la requête qui donne un résultat erroné et les lignes ou le total attendus. Le périmètre et les conditions dépendent du cas reproductible.', '', '## Reproduction', '', f'SQLite {sqlite3.sqlite_version}, in-memory database. Fixture SHA-256 `{hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}`.', '', '```sql', case['setup_sql'], '']
for query in case['queries'].values():
    lines.append(query + ';')
lines.extend(['```', ''])
out = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/bespoke-inbound/invoice-total-worked-example-en-fr.md')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text('\n'.join(lines), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(out), 'sqlite_version': sqlite3.sqlite_version, 'observed_cents': observed, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
